proyecto.revision.d: Review the process memory, the discrepancies, the inventory and the proposed rules. When everything looks right, activate monitoring.

proyecto.cfg.aviso: If you changed repos or processes, re-analyzing is recommended: the routine regenerates the memory and the inventory.
proyecto.reglas.ejemplo: E.g.: if more than 10 login errors in a row are seen, escalate
proyecto.reglas.crearAviso: The routine translates it into a check on the next run and shows how it understood it.
proyecto.reglas.sub: Checks written in plain language. The routine proposes rules and changes (from responses to incidents, from similarity between processes and in its daily review); {quien}.
proyecto.reglas.subAuto: new rules are activated automatically and an Admin applies the changes
proyecto.ajustes.soloAdmin: Only Admins can view the settings.
proyecto.ajustes.loHaceCorrida: The next run will do it.
proyecto.ajustes.sub: Which Orchestrator folder is monitored, the global triage criteria, the thresholds and the rules.
proyecto.ajustes.carpetaHint: (if there are several, separate them with commas)
proyecto.ajustes.escaneoExplica: The routine goes through all the folders inside it and proposes each one that has processes as a project. This is the first step on a new dashboard.
proyecto.ajustes.autoTitulo: Automatically approve the rules the routine proposes
proyecto.ajustes.autoOn: On: the rules the routine proposes become active immediately, without going through a person. Afterwards they can be disabled, edited or deleted.
proyecto.ajustes.autoOff: Off: each rule the routine proposes waits for an Admin to approve it.
proyecto.ajustes.autoNota: Suggested changes to existing rules are always applied by a person. It is saved as soon as you change it.
proyecto.ajustes.rolesTxt: Reader = Viewer access, Operator = Contributor, Admin = Editor. They are assigned from the dashboard's Share menu.
proyecto.reg.todosAviso: The routine analyzes up to 3 per run. Each one stays In review until you activate it.
proyecto.reg.todosTip: Ignore the ones you do not want to monitor (test, development) and register the rest at once.
proyecto.reg.ignoradas.one: {n} folder ignored: it is not proposed.
proyecto.reg.ignoradas.other: {n} folders ignored: they are not proposed.
proyecto.reg.bannerPedido: Scan requested: the next run proposes the projects it finds here.
proyecto.reg.bannerSinNuevas: The last scan found no new folders with processes.
